title: ‘That is recklessness’: Florida's staunch GOP AI opponents slam Altman's ‘bad things’ comments
source_used: none: Politico's page returned 403 and no other outlet carries the story; only the headline and page address were available
why_it_matters_hint: From the headline only: Florida Republicans who strongly oppose AI have attacked Altman's 'bad things' comments.
event_date: Politico story published 6 Oct 2026 00:46Z; it answers Altman's remark in the Politico Decoded interview (our 5 Oct edition item 96)
notes: Politico's page returned 403 and no text could be obtained. Google News searches on five keyword sets (Uthmeier, Altman, Florida, 'bad things', recklessness) found no other outlet carrying the story. The page address contains 'uthmeier-ag', apparently Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier, but the headline names no one, so the entry does not. Background read for the importance line only: The Capitolist reports that Uthmeier sued OpenAI and Altman over ChatGPT (complaint filed 1 June) and on 28 Sep asked a court for a temporary injunction. The headline quotes 'That is recklessness' without naming the speaker.
